protocol.name: meter-first full-store rho, 1024 workers declared, depth 6, evicting dict
protocol.abort: K_STALL=32 consecutive squarings, armed by a guard admission
protocol.meter: one global counter in instructions; every step, key build, probe, record write, replay and verification asks fits() before acting; a replay or verification that does not fit abandons that worker

worker_fidelity.why: trail >= guard ring (6) is required for the guard statistics to be at stationarity; at ratio 1.4493 the fixture admits W <= 8 before trail < ring.  W enters only through trail; the partition series D/E/F measures p_hat against W at FIXED S, which is the only W-dependence the fixture can carry.

claim.rule: minimal n with 20000*2^(n/10000) >= W, exact integer check; n-1 asserted to fail

row_derivations.walk_steps: steps x STEP; STEP = f_mul x 47924 + (1-f_mul) x 25372; f_mul = 0.996795 measured
row_derivations.per_step_lookup_key_and_probe: steps x 3685 Ir = state_key48w 2926 + dict28_lookup 759, both MAX executed counts
row_derivations.record_writes_and_insert: steps x 1912 Ir (688 B serialize + dict28_insert 1224)
row_derivations.trap_waste_bound: short families exact 0 (no slot repeats inside ring 6, W(1)=0); long families bounded from 4940101 observed windows at depth 6 with 0 admissions: one-sided 95%% Poisson limit 2.996/N x ring-overlap 6, 3.4861e+32 windows at S, x delay 32 x STEP

charges.MUL_DERIVATION: MUL_CHARGE = executed(f12mul) = 47924 Ir for ONE dense Fp12 multiplication.  The shipped f12mul makes FOUR Fp6 multiplications, hence 72 base-field multiplications with these kernels (v28 printed 54 and 887.48 Ir/Fp mul, verdict flaw 4); per Fp mul = 665.61 Ir.  v27 charged 22409 = 47924 - 25515 with no derivation; that discount is withdrawn.
charges.price_basis: executed counts, measured: loop-free kernels (gcov executed per call == static span) and looped dict symbols (charge = MAX executed over census traffic and the worst path)

v27_discount_withdrawn.effect: the multiply step is priced at one dense Fp12 multiplication; the v27 claim under-priced 64% of the steps by 2.14x

addressing.single_formula: bytes = records x 688 + ceil(records/0.625) x 9 x 8 + 1024 x 256 + 1024 x 6 x 8 + 2^20
addressing.v27_flaw: dict26.c shipped eight-word entries with 64-bit slot ids and int-valued returns; v28 ships nine-word entries with a 128-bit ref field and the address computed as mulhi128(hash, cap) from four 64x64 products

dictionary.charge_rule: max(loop-free static span, worst executed per call)

measured.observer: windows of length 2..12 tested for EVERY period p <= 12 (not only 2-slot alternating words), at depth 6

trap.independence: the Poisson upper limit needs independent windows and is reported under that hypothesis; the charge does not use it
trap.v27_flaw: gen27.py set measured_rate=3/(7680000/6) and called it a window bound; v28 deletes that route from the code and charges the exact census expectation, which needs no independence

eviction.note: the shipped arm (dict28.o) and the control (dict28_nolru.o, same source, drop instead of evict) differ only in the eviction policy; both ran at depth 6 with the shipped key routine and the shipped load factor

success.procedure: draw Beta(k+1,n-k+1) for each census arm and for retention, multiply the minimum census draw by the retention draw, take the 5th percentile; the v27 independently-uniform residual divisor is deleted
success.v27_flaw: 0.41336 was a quantile of an assumed product (uniform divisor); v28 has no assumed factor

survival.note: one fixture scale; the retention draw is the only survival factor

tie_analysis.resolution: kappa = ks.index(min(ks)) is the FIRST minimum (deterministic); the pool slot is derived from sorted(ks), invariant to which rotation attains the minimum, so a tie cannot fork the table index or the record key.
